title: Nanotsume Beading Tray v3
description:
Personally, I don't like beading mats because the needle gets stuck when picking up beads. I also avoid those small triangle trays since they easily flip over if you accidentally hit a corner. So this model is my take on the ideal beading tray.

In addition to the main tray, you can also print a matching lid (it’s a few millimeters wider so it can fit on top or work as a second tray).
